title: The derived limit of the tower adjunction is an integral adjunction
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$ of characteristic $p$ and its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Use the completed integral coefficient sheaves, the derived-complete categories $\Dbc(-,\mathcal O_E)$, coefficient towers and normalized constructible towers [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. Reductions are derived tensor products with $(\mathcal O_E/\ell^n)_T$ for $n\geq1$; integral pullback and twists mean [def-pur-integral-derived-operations, def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Use the compact-support direct image of [det-sp-integral-direct-image-tower] (with a compactification $f=\bar f\circ j$) and the tower adjunction of [det-sp-tower-gluing].

For $K\in\Dbc(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ the tower $f_\bullet^!\operatorname{red}_YK$ is normalized
constructible, so
$H_{f,\mathcal O_E}(K)=R\varprojlim_nf^!_{\mathcal O_E/\ell^n}(K/\ell^n)\in\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$
and $\operatorname{red}_XH_{f,\mathcal O_E}(K)\simeq f_\bullet^!\operatorname{red}_YK$. For
$M\in\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$ there are bijections, natural in $M$ and $K$,

$$
\operatorname{Hom}(Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}M,K)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(Rf_{!,\bullet}\operatorname{red}_XM,\operatorname{red}_YK)
\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(\operatorname{red}_XM,f_\bullet^!\operatorname{red}_YK)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(M,H_{f,\mathcal O_E}(K)),
$$

so $Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}\dashv H_{f,\mathcal O_E}$, with unit and counit the derived
limits of the tower unit and counit, whose reductions are the finite units and
counits. Moreover
$\gamma_{f,\mathcal O_E}^H(K)=R\varprojlim\gamma_{f,\bullet}(\operatorname{red}_YK):
f^*_{\mathcal O_E}K(d)[2d]\xrightarrow{\sim}H_{f,\mathcal O_E}(K)$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Use lem-sp-integral-adjunction-reconstruction-package to obtain the specified Reconstruction package, including canonical left and right comparisons, fully faithful reductions, and actual-unit reconstruction identities.

Apply [lem-sp-fully-faithful-adjunction-restriction] to $i=r_X$, $j=r_Y$, $F'=F_\bullet$, $G'=G_\bullet$ on those subcategories and the comparisons $b,c$ from Step 1. Its Hom chain is exactly the three claimed bijections: the first sends $a$ to $r_Y(a)b_M^{-1}$; the last sends $h$ to the unique $\widetilde h$ with $r_X\widetilde h=c_K^{-1}h$. Naturality and both triangles follow from the cited lemma. Its formulas give
$$r_X\eta_M=c_{FM}^{-1}G_\bullet(b_M^{-1})\eta^\bullet_{r_XM},\qquad r_Y\varepsilon_K=\varepsilon^\bullet_{r_YK}F_\bullet(c_K)b_{HK}.$$
The unit is the image of $1_{FM}$ and the counit the inverse image of $1_{HK}$.

By Step 1's reconstruction identity $a=u_B^{-1}L_T(r_Ta)u_A$, the two maps just computed are exactly the derived limits of the tower unit and counit under $b,c,u$. Clause (3) of [det-sp-tower-gluing] identifies their level $n$ reductions with the finite units and counits. This uses actual tower maps, so requires no lifting of an arbitrary family of component maps.

Apply twistedPullbackReductionTower for integral source membership and its natural comparison to finiteSource. Compose with lem-sp-integral-adjunction-ordered-source. For any such source comparison, gamma is invertible by tower-gamma, the reconstruction unit is invertible by normalized-equivalence and the intrinsic completeness comparison, and all images of these isomorphisms remain invertible. Thus the displayed actual realization is an isomorphism.

blueprint_update.statement:
For $K\in\Dbc(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ the tower $f_\bullet^!\operatorname{red}_YK$ is normalized
constructible, so
$H_{f,\mathcal O_E}(K)=R\varprojlim_nf^!_{\mathcal O_E/\ell^n}(K/\ell^n)\in\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$
and $\operatorname{red}_XH_{f,\mathcal O_E}(K)\simeq f_\bullet^!\operatorname{red}_YK$. For
$M\in\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$ there are bijections, natural in $M$ and $K$,

$$
\operatorname{Hom}(Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}M,K)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(Rf_{!,\bullet}\operatorname{red}_XM,\operatorname{red}_YK)
\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(\operatorname{red}_XM,f_\bullet^!\operatorname{red}_YK)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(M,H_{f,\mathcal O_E}(K)),
$$

so $Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}\dashv H_{f,\mathcal O_E}$, with unit and counit the derived
limits of the tower unit and counit, whose reductions are the finite units and
counits. Moreover
$\gamma_{f,\mathcal O_E}^H(K)=R\varprojlim\gamma_{f,\bullet}(\operatorname{red}_YK):

proof.text:
*Normalization.* $\operatorname{red}_YK$ is normalized constructible, and $f^!_\bullet$
preserves normalized constructible towers ([det-sp-tower-gamma], (3)). By the
equivalence of [det-sp-normalized-equivalence], $H_{f,\mathcal O_E}(K)=R\varprojlim
f^!_\bullet\operatorname{red}_YK$ lies in $\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$ and
$\operatorname{red}_XH_{f,\mathcal O_E}(K)\simeq f^!_\bullet\operatorname{red}_YK$ (counit isomorphism on
normalized towers). Functoriality of $H$ follows from that of $f^!_\bullet$.

*Bijections.* The first bijection is full faithfulness of $\operatorname{red}$ on
$\Dbc(-,\mathcal O_E)$ ([det-sp-normalized-equivalence]) combined with
$\operatorname{red}_YRf_{!,\mathcal O_E}M\simeq Rf_{!,\bullet}\operatorname{red}_XM$
([det-sp-integral-direct-image-tower]). The second is the tower adjunction of
[det-sp-tower-gluing]. The third is full faithfulness of $\operatorname{red}$ again,
with the identification of $\operatorname{red}_XH(K)$ above. Each is natural in both
variables, so the composite defines an adjunction. Its counit, the image of
$\mathrm{id}_{H(K)}$, corresponds under $\operatorname{red}$ to the tower counit, so it is
$R\varprojlim$ of the tower counit; similarly for the unit. By
[det-sp-tower-gluing] their levels are the finite units and counits.

*Purity.* $\gamma_{f,\bullet}(\operatorname{red}_YK)$ is an isomorphism of towers
([det-sp-tower-gamma]); its source is $\operatorname{red}_X(f^*K(d)[2d])$ because
pullback, twist and shift commute with reduction. Applying $R\varprojlim$ and
the unit isomorphism for derived complete objects [def-pe-derived-complete] gives the isomorphism
$f^*_{\mathcal O_E}K(d)[2d]\simeq H_{f,\mathcal O_E}(K)$.
